title: Concept explainer
summary: Turn a document, a slide deck or a topic into an easy-to-follow video.
description: Help viewers understand a concept with clear explanations and concrete examples. Your material is shaped into a visual story, pitched to what the audience already knows.
brief: Using {{source material}}, explain {{topic}} to {{audience}} so that afterwards they can {{learning goal}}.

fields.label: source material
fields.hint: Attached documents, slides or links; if you have none, write "public sources"

fields.label: audience
fields.hint: Who is watching and how much they already know

fields.label: topic
fields.hint: The concept or topic to explain

fields.label: learning goal
fields.hint: What viewers should remember or be able to do afterwards
fields.example: describe what the light and dark reactions each do

beats: Make it click with an example
